items.exampleEn: Who will make arrangements for your visit?
items.exampleZh: 誰會為您的來訪做安排？

items.exampleEn: This old car doesn't meet the requirements of the new law.
items.exampleZh: 這輛舊車不符合新法規的要求。

items.exampleEn: On behalf of everyone here, thank you.
items.exampleZh: 我代表在場的每一個人向你道謝。

items.exampleEn: Plastic waste poses a threat to sea animals.
items.exampleZh: 塑膠垃圾對海洋動物構成威脅。

items.exampleEn: Running a business is harder than it looks.
Students who set a goal usually study harder.
items.exampleZh: 有設定目標的學生通常比較用功。

items.exampleEn: Why don't you take a day off and relax?
items.exampleZh: 你何不請一天假放鬆一下？

items.sentenceEn: Some plants pose a threat to local farms.
items.sentenceZh: 有些植物對當地農場構成威脅。

items.audioEn: I'm taking a day off on Thursday to help my sister move into her new apartment.
items.audioZh: 我星期四要請一天假，幫我姊姊搬進她的新公寓。
items.questionZh: 說話者星期四為什麼請假？
options: To go on a short trip with friends
To paint the walls of the office
To help a family member move house

items.sentenceEn: This room meets the requirements for a classroom.
items.sentenceZh: 這個房間符合當教室的要求。

items.sentenceEn: I'm calling on behalf of Mr. Lin.
items.sentenceZh: 我代表林先生打這通電話。

items.stemEn: Sorry, your application doesn't ____ for this job.
items.stemZh: 抱歉，你的申請不符合這份工作的要求。

items.stemEn: We need to ____ for the guests who are arriving on Friday.
items.stemZh: 我們得為星期五要來的客人做好安排。

items.passageEn: Mr. Yang has run a business for twenty years, and he still loves it. He owns a small shop that repairs bicycles. At the start of each year, he sets a goal for the shop, such as fixing a thousand bikes. Last year he worked every day and never took a day off. This year, he has made arrangements for his nephew to help on weekends, so he can finally rest a little. He says his family is more important than any goal.
items.passageZh: 楊先生經營事業已經二十年了，到現在還是很喜歡。他開了一家修理腳踏車的小店。每年年初，他都會為店裡設定一個目標，例如修好一千輛腳踏車。去年他每天都工作，一天假都沒請。今年他安排姪子週末來幫忙，所以終於可以稍微休息。他說家人比任何目標都重要。

questions.questionZh: 楊先生每年年初會做什麼？
options: 帶全家人出國旅行一個星期

questions.questionZh: 今年楊先生為什麼終於能休息一下？
options: 他把店交給兒子經營了
店裡請了兩位全職員工
今年修腳踏車的客人變少了

referenceEn: I'd like to take a day off next Monday.
I want to take a day off next Monday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「請一天假」（例如 take a day off 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 take next Monday off、ask for a day off next Monday 等）
「想」可寫，例如 would like to、want to 等
「下週一」可寫，例如 next Monday 等，可放句首或句尾

items.promptZh: 我叔叔在台南經營事業。
referenceEn: My uncle runs a business in Tainan.
My uncle is running a business in Tainan.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「經營事業」（例如 runs a business 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 has a business、owns a business、runs his own business 等）
時態可用現在簡單式或現在進行式（例如 runs、is running 等）
主詞是單數，用現在簡單式時動詞加 s（例如 runs 等）
